QUOTE: `programs/ssl/ssl_client2.c:8` | The `ssl_client2` example/test program. ... They compile against mbedtls internals, so a field rename or restructure will break them, but external applications will not be affected.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies that the example programs ssl_client2 and ssl_server2 define MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS themselves, so they reach past the public API into library internals.
